messages:
mira: Pushed the 'prefetch-hold-shadow' tweak to canary pools this morning. Short headline: p50 ~13% lower, p99 ~21% lower on interactive traces; token cost ~8.6% lower on average. No model changes, just runtime heuristics. :sparkles:

release-bot: canary stats (canary-13 -> prod snapshot):
- p50 latency: 88ms -> 76ms (-13.6%)
- p99 latency: 410ms -> 324ms (-20.98%)
- token cost: $0.0092 -> $0.0084 (-8.7%)
- error rate: 0.018% -> 0.019% (steady)

henry: nice! what's the mechanism? more batching or smarter prefetch?

mira: two small pieces: 1) microbatcher adds a predictive hold window (configurable up to 9ms) for tiny requests when a prefix-match probability is high, 2) a shadow-LRU tracks recently-prefetched prefix keys and serves a lightweight in-memory hint to skip remote KV fetches for short-tail traffic. Combined they avoid token duplication and reduce remote fetch stalls.

sasha: any known gotchas? particularly for very-long-context or heavy-embedding jobs?

mira: flagged in runbook: very-long-context jobs (>128k tokens) can increase memory pressure with shadow LRU; those tenants will be default-opted-out. Added opt-out flag: `runtime.disable_prefetch_hold_shadow=true`.

ops: can we get a simple verification command for pool owners?

henry: healthcheck we used:
```
# quick p99 compare per pool
python infra/check_delta.py --metric p99_latency --from canary-13 --to prod --group pool --threshold 0.1
```

telemetry-bot: posting graph link: https://metrics.redwood/internal/dashboards/prefetch-hold-shadow (internal)

sasha: please draft a one-line for ops and cs. include opt-out and runbook link.

mira: Draft: "Deployed prefetch-hold-shadow: p50 -13%, p99 -21%, token cost -8.7%. Opt-out: runtime.disable_prefetch_hold_shadow=true. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/prefetch-hold-shadow" :white_check_mark:

release-bot: feature `runtime.prefetch_hold_shadow` enabled on pools: gpu-us-east-1a, gpu-eu-west-1a. Rolling to more pools in 30m.

mira: thanks team 9extra kudos to infra-microbatch and kv-prefetch folks. will follow up with a short post including latency histograms and token-cost breakdowns later today. :party_parrot:
